skills.name: styleref-figma
skills.description: Apply a named visual style or brand look to a Figma file — writing its palette as local color variables, its type rules as text styles, and its full spec as generation context so new frames come out on-brand. Also captures the style already present in a selection into a reusable, portable spec. Use this whenever the user asks for work to be on-brand, consistent, or in a particular aesthetic ("match our brand", "warm editorial look", "keep every screen consistent", "turn this into a style guide"), whenever they name a style or paste a styleref.io link, and whenever no published design library covers the look they want. Styles are read from styleref.io's public gallery over web fetch — no account, plugin, or connector is required to apply one.
headings: StyleRef — apply a brand or visual style to the Figma canvas
Lane A — apply a style to the file
Lane B — capture the style already on the canvas
Honest claims — do not break these

Use when the user wants a consistent style, aesthetic, or brand look for AI-generated content — images, copy, UI, video — or asks to set up STYLE.md for a project. Covers finding a style, applying it per tool (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, FLUX, Stable Diffusion), and keeping outputs consistent.
